subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to make the whole story. Only the corresponding numbers of the
stimulus: sentences need to be written. 1  8 = 8 (a) In 1914 when the 1st World War broke out, he wanted to join the army. (b) At last, at the age of 19 he joined the army as an ordinary soldier on the side of the alliance. (c) At the age of eleven, he showed his poetic genius. (d) Our national poet Kazi Nazrul Islam was born in 1306 B.S (1899 A.D) at Churulia in the district of Burdhwan. (e) On his returned from the battlefield, he gave up the sword for the pen and began to write poems. (f) He breathed his last on 29 August, 1976. (g) In 1972 he was brought to Bangladesh from Kolkata and was declared our national poet. (h) His poems inspired our freedom fighters in the Liberation War of Bangladesh. Part−B : Writing Test [50 Marks]
guide_solution: 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 d c a b e h g f Our national poet Kazi Nazrul Islam was born in 1306 B.S (1899 A.D) at Churulia in the district of Burdhwan. At the age of eleven, he showed his poetic genius. In 1914 when the 1st World War broke out, he wanted to join the army. At last, at the age of 19 he joined the army as an ordinary soldier on the side of the alliance. On his returned from the battlefield, he gave up the sword for the pen and began to write poems. His poems inspired our freedom fighters in the Liberation War of Bangladesh. In 1972 he was brought to Bangladesh from Kolkata and was declared our national poet. He breathed his last on 29 August, 1976. Part−B : Writing Test See SSC English Made Easy To Test Papers Book
